chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shamoun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Misma' ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Eat the apple, for it repairs the stomach.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating apples according to Imam Ali (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophetic tradition of dietary medicine, where Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) recommends apples for their astringent properties that 'toughen' or firm up the stomach, aiding digestion. In Shia scholarly tradition, this reflects the holistic view of the Imams, integrating practical health advice with spiritual well-being, emphasizing that food serves both physical nourishment and bodily resilience.
